page.layout: One page, blank except for a small printed coat of arms in the centre (a shield with a Maltese cross, mantling and crossed banners, no printed words). Library stamp at the top left and handwriting, shelf marks and a digitiser's credit are not printed text and are omitted.
page.notes: No printed text. The centre holds a coat of arms: a shield with a cross, supporters and crossed palm or banner shapes, with no lettering. Omitted as not printed on the book page: the Biblioteca Nazionale "Vittorio Emanuele" stamp (13 / 23 D / 24) at top left, the handwritten "M" and "XIV 6.n.3" and "K.9" marks, the shelf mark "13-19.e.35.", and the "Digitized by Google" credit at bottom right.
